sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthdate FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN encounters AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Outpatient Encounter'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.DESCRIPTION, T4.DESCRIPTION, T5.DESCRIPTION, T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN encounters T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT JOIN careplans T3 ON T2.ID=T3.ENCOUNTER JOIN procedures T4 ON T2.ID=T4.ENCOUNTER JOIN medications T5 ON T2.ID=T5.ENCOUNTER WHERE T2.ID='6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.PATIENT END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.PATIENT END) AS difference FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Glucose'

SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND substr(T1.START, 1, 4) = '2017'

SELECT MAX(T1.DATE) FROM immunizations AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PATIENT), T2.DESCRIPTION FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.START FROM careplans AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.maiden = 'Adams'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN T1.deathdate IS NULL THEN (julianday(substr(datetime('now'),1,10))-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 ELSE (julianday(T1.deathdate)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 END) FROM patients T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Hypertension' AND T1.gender='M'
